## Objective
- Build a complete, playable single-file Three.js game, “Gravity Switcher 3D,” in the existing project.
- Validate gameplay and presentation in-browser, fixing discovered issues.

## Requirements
- WASD/arrow movement, mouse look with Pointer Lock, gravity switching with G/Space toward an aimed surface or upside-down gravity, and camera rotation.
- One low-poly level with floor, wall, and ceiling routes; collect three shards to unlock an exit; laser and falling hazards reset player.
- Minimal HUD for shard count, gravity direction, and restart; deliver as copy-paste-ready HTML using Three.js CDN.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport at most 1280px wide) and inspect the latest one.

- Implemented a compact orbital vault scene with a player box, platforms, shards, laser, portal, and HUD in `index.html`.
- Gravity switches toward the aimed surface using its face normal; with no suitable surface hit, it reverses gravity.
